title: President Trump announces Medicare Part B premium payments for seniors
excerpt: The federal government will issue one-time $90 payments to over 20 million Medicare enrollees in October 2026.
bodyHtml:
On October 2, 2026, the White House announced that the federal government will issue one-time payments of $90 to more than 20 million Medicare Part B enrollees. The payments are intended to help enrollees pay for their Medicare Part B premiums.

The payments will be drawn from the Medicare Improvement Fund, which received $2 billion from Congress. This marks the first time the fund has been utilized for such payments since its establishment in 2008.

Most eligible seniors will receive the funds via direct deposit or check in early October 2026. Those whose premiums are already paid by Medicaid or who pay an Income-Related Monthly Adjustment Amount do not qualify for the payments.

Beneficiaries who want to check on the status of their payment should call the Social Security Administration at 1-800-772-1213. Seniors can also call 1-800-MEDICARE to check on their eligibility for the premium rebate.
